title: Protest against compulsory military service on 4 March, with a march to the Ministry of Defence
reason: Below 50 participants: the opened LETA-origin LSM/LTV report estimates approximately ten at the public gathering by the Freedom Monument. The same small group later began a march; no evidence shows it grew to 50 or more simultaneously.
notes: State-policy demand is clear (make the new service voluntary/strengthen existing defense structures), but threshold is not met. TVNET and Jauns results are not counted as independent confirmation; exact body requests on both returned tool-level fetch failures and remain search-only.

title: Legionnaires’ memorial march and flower-laying at the Freedom Monument
reason: Not a protest under the project definition: the several-hundred-person crowd attended a commemorative service/procession and laid flowers; the report describes no demand on Latvia’s government or policy.
notes: Keep the large memorial march distinct from the one-person counter-protest reported at the same location. Main crowd has hundreds, but size alone does not make a protest.

title: Andrejs Pagors’s individual counter-protest against the Legionnaires’ memorial
reason: Below the 50-person threshold: LETA reports one individual with a placard protesting the memorial; this is separate from the memorial crowd.
notes: Do not aggregate the one counter-protester with the commemorative march. No larger counter-gathering was reported in the source.
